expected_request.instruction: Use the explicit age, retention, and hold fields to draft a retention review checklist. Cite RET-* IDs and state that eligibility is not deletion authority; request legal-hold, jurisdiction, owner, and schedule verification.

content.text:
EVIDENCE: RET-01
RET-01 is 65 days beyond its supplied 365-day period and has no listed hold. Verify jurisdiction, owner, schedule version, and any unrecorded hold before disposition.
